question: ‘What Happened to Netaji’ was written by whom among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anuj Dhar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **What Happened to Netaji?"** is a book written by **Anuj Dhar**, published in **2005**.
 
• The book delves into the mysterious disappearance of **Subhas Chandra Bose** (Netaji) in **1945**, exploring various theories and questions regarding his fate after he was reportedly last seen in **Taipei**, Taiwan, following a plane crash.
 
• Anuj Dhar investigates the official accounts surrounding Bose's death and raises questions about the authenticity of these claims.
 
• The book argues that the government of India may have concealed information about Netaji's whereabouts, and it also highlights various conspiracy theories about his possible survival and the role of the Indian government in suppressing the truth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arvind Adiga** is known for his book *"The White Tiger,"* which won the Booker Prize in 2008.
 
• **Vikram Seth** is famous for his works like *"A Suitable Boy"*.
 
• **Kiran Desai** is the author of *"The Inheritance of Loss,"* which won the Booker Prize in 2006.
